.progress-line, .progress-line:before {

.progress-line {
    background-color: #5a686f;
    display: -webkit-flex;
    display: flex;
    margin-top: 4rem;
    width: 15vw;  
}
.progress-line:before {
  background-color: #3e545e;
  content: '';
  -webkit-animation: running-progress 2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) infinite;
  animation: running-progress 2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) infinite;
}
@-webkit-keyframes running-progress {
  0% { margin-left: 0px; margin-right: 100%; }
  50% { margin-left: 25%; margin-right: 0%; }
  100% { margin-left: 100%; margin-right: 0; }
}
@keyframes running-progress {
  0% { margin-left: 0px; margin-right: 100%; }
  50% { margin-left: 25%; margin-right: 0%; }
  100% { margin-left: 100%; margin-right: 0; }
}


.progress-line-2 {
    background-color: #F6F6F5;
    width: 100%;
    position: relative;
    height: 12px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.progress-line-2 .progress-inner {
    background-color: #19A975;
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 0%;
    height: 100%;
    border-radius: 10px;    
}


.progress-line-2 .progress-start {
    width: 100%;
    transition: 15s ease;
}

.progress-line-2 .progress-inner.progress-inner-ending {
    left: 0;
    width: 50%;    
    -webkit-animation: running-progress 2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) infinite;
    animation: running-progress 2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) infinite;
    transition: none;
}

/* The element to hover over */
.qs {
    position: relative;
}
.qs .popover {
  background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85);
  border-radius: 5px;
  bottom: 42px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
  color: #fff;
  display: none;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-family: "Helvetica", sans-serif;
  left: -5px;
  padding: 7px 10px;
  position: absolute;
    width: 100vw;
    max-width: 300px;
  z-index: 4;
}
.qs .popover:before {
  border-top: 7px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85);
  border-right: 7px solid transparent;
  border-left: 7px solid transparent;
  bottom: -7px;
  content: "";
  display: block;
  left: 19px;
  margin-left: -7px;
  position: absolute;
}
.qs:hover .popover {
  display: block;
  -webkit-animation: fade-in 0.3s linear 1, move-up 0.3s linear 1;
  -moz-animation: fade-in 0.3s linear 1, move-up 0.3s linear 1;
  -ms-animation: fade-in 0.3s linear 1, move-up 0.3s linear 1;
}

.pop-info {
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-decoration-style: dashed;
    text-underline-offset: 3px;
    text-decoration-thickness: 1px;
}

@-webkit-keyframes fade-in {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
  }
}
@-moz-keyframes fade-in {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
  }
}
@-ms-keyframes fade-in {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
  }
}
@-webkit-keyframes move-up {
  from {
    bottom: 30px;
  }
  to {
    bottom: 42px;
  }
}
@-moz-keyframes move-up {
  from {
    bottom: 30px;
  }
  to {
    bottom: 42px;
  }
}
@-ms-keyframes move-up {
  from {
    bottom: 30px;
  }
  to {
    bottom: 42px;
  }
}

/*******************************
PAGE PRELOADER
    Shared between admin/stats dashboards (page-load splash) and the
    marketing / plans / features pages (Stripe checkout overlay). Toggled
    via $.preload() in utils.js or directly via $('#preloader').fadeIn()
    / fadeOut() from payment.js. The `.trans` variant is the transparent
    overlay used during AJAX flows.
*******************************/
    #preloader {
        position: fixed;
        top: 0;
        left: 0;
        right: 0;
        bottom: 0;
        z-index: 99999;
        background: #19a974;
    }

    #status {
        position: relative;
        display: flex;
        justify-content: center;
        align-items: center;
        height: 100%;
    }

    #status svg {
        width: 100%;
        height: auto;
        display: block;
        max-width: 75px;
    }

    #status svg path {
        fill: white;
        animation: anipreloaderfade 2.5s linear infinite;
    }

    #status svg .animate-path {
        fill: none;
        stroke-dasharray: 160;
        stroke-dashoffset: 160;
        animation: anipreloader 2.5s linear infinite;
        stroke-width: 3px;
        stroke: white;
    }

    .trans #status {
        position: relative;
        display: flex;
        justify-content: center;
        align-items: center;
        height: 25px;
        width: 50%;
        left: 25%;
        top: calc(50% - 100px);
        background-color: #ffffff7a;
        border-radius: 18px;
        z-index: -2
    }

    .trans #status svg {
        width: 100%;
        height: auto;
        display: block;
        max-width: 75px;
        margin-top: 23px;
    }

    #preloader.trans {
        background: #0000004f;
    }

    .trans #status::after {
        content: '';
        background-color: #3eaa83;
        width: 30%;
        position: absolute;
        left: 0;
        top: 0;
        height: 100%;
        border-radius: 18px;
        animation: anitrans 3s linear infinite;
        z-index: -1;
    }

    @keyframes anitrans {
      0% {
        left: 0%;
        width: 0%;
      }
      50% {
        left: 25%;
        width: 50%;
      }
      100% {
        width: 0%;
        left: 100%;
      }
    }

    @keyframes anipreloader {
      0% {
        stroke-dashoffset: 160;
        opacity: 0;
      }
      80% {
        stroke-dashoffset: 0;
        opacity: 1;
      }
      95% {
        stroke-dashoffset: 0;
        opacity: 0;
      }
      100% {
        stroke-dashoffset: 0;
        opacity: 0;
      }
    }

    @keyframes anipreloaderfade {
      0% {
        opacity: 0;
      }
      50% {
        stroke-dashoffset: 0;
        opacity: 1;
      }
      95% {
        stroke-dashoffset: 0;
        opacity: 1;
      }
      100% {
        opacity: 0;
      }
    }

.pay-loading {

    top: 0;
    left: 0;

    z-index: 999;
    display: none;
    justify-content: center;

@keyframes ldio-z2hnrfluhhg {
  0% { transform: scale(1.1500000000000001) }
  100% { transform: scale(1) }
}
.loading div {
  position: absolute;
  width: 80px;
  height: 80px;
  top: 13.333333333333336px;
  left: 13.333333333333336px;
  background: #77878e;
  animation: ldio-z2hnrfluhhg 1s cubic-bezier(0,0.5,0.5,1) infinite;
  animation-delay: -0.3s;
}
.loading div:nth-child(2) {
  top: 13.333333333333336px;
  left: 106.66666666666666px;
  background: #d3d3d3;
  animation-delay: -0.2s;
}
.loading div:nth-child(3) {
  top: 106.66666666666666px;
  left: 13.333333333333336px;
  background: #3e545e;
  animation-delay: 0s;
}
.loading div:nth-child(4) {
  top: 106.66666666666666px;
  left: 106.66666666666666px;
  background: #e8e7e7;
  animation-delay: -0.1s;
}
.loading-spinner {
  width: 200px;
  height: 200px;
  display: inline-block;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: #ffffff;
}
.loading {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  position: relative;
  transform: translateZ(0) scale(1);
  backface-visibility: hidden;
  transform-origin: 0 0; /* see note above */
}
.loading div { box-sizing: content-box; }

/* ==== Subscription plan-selector (modal + inline on the account page) ==== */

/* Modal wrapper specifics: scrolling, sizing, surface */
.modal-plan-select.backdrop {
    overflow-y: auto;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
    z-index: 10000;
}

.modal-plan-select .content {
    max-width: 960px;
    width: 92%;
    margin: 0 auto;
    position: relative;
    height: auto;
    left: 0;
    top: 0;
}

.modal-plan-select .content > div {
    max-width: 960px;
    background-color: white;
    border: 1px solid #e3ebe8;
    margin: 2rem auto;
    padding: 2rem;
}

/* Shared plan-selector content (works inside the modal and inline) */
.plan-selector .plan-select-title {
    margin: 0 0 0.5rem;
    text-align: center;
    font-family: HKGrotesk;
    font-size: 1.6rem;
    color: #05241A;
}

.plan-selector .plan-select-controls {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    margin: 2px 0 13px;
}

.plan-selector .plan-select-period {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
}

/* Period toggle (matches the home pricing toggle) */
.plan-selector .price-toggle {
    position: relative;
    display: inline-block;
    width: 280px;
    height: 38px;
}

.plan-selector .price-toggle-input {
    display: none;
}

.plan-selector .price-toggle-label {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 280px;
    height: 38px;
    background-color: #e3ebe8;
    border-radius: 38px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: 0.4s;
}

.plan-selector .price-toggle-label::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    top: 4px;
    left: 4px;
    width: 140px;
    height: 30px;
    background-color: #19a975;
    border-radius: 30px;
    transition: transform 0.4s;
}

.plan-selector .price-toggle-input:checked + .price-toggle-label {
    background-color: #e3ebe8;
}

.plan-selector .price-toggle-input:checked + .price-toggle-label::before {
    transform: translateX(132px);
}

.plan-selector .price-toggle-text {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-around;
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: white;
    pointer-events: none;
}

.plan-selector .price-toggle-annual {
    color: white;
}

.plan-selector .price-toggle-input:checked + .price-toggle-label + .price-toggle-text .price-toggle-annual {
    color: #262b38;
    font-weight: normal;
}

.plan-selector .price-toggle-monthly {
    color: #262b38;
    font-weight: normal;
}

.plan-selector .price-toggle-input:checked + .price-toggle-label + .price-toggle-text .price-toggle-monthly {
    color: white;
}

.plan-selector .plan-select-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 16px;
}

.plan-selector .plan-select-item {
    background: #fafbfc;
    border: 1px solid #e5e8ec;
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 18px 16px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

.plan-selector .plan-select-item .product-title {
    font-size: 1.1rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    margin: 0 0 6px;
}

.plan-selector .plan-select-item .product-price {
    margin: 0 0 8px;
}

/* Make the headline price big and bold */
.plan-selector .plan-select-item .product-price .pricing-price {
    font-family: HKGrotesk;
    font-size: 2rem;
    font-weight: normal;
    color: #05241A;
    line-height: 1.05;
    letter-spacing: -0.5px;
}

.plan-selector .plan-select-item .product-price .pricing-period {
    font-size: 1rem;
    color: #5a6a64;
    margin-left: 2px;
}

            $(this).find('.close').trigger('click');
        }

        if (!mu.is(':visible')) {
            mu.fadeIn('fast');
        } else {
            mu.fadeOut('fast');
        }
        return false;
    });

    $('.btnExample').on('click', function() {
        $('#mdlFlipbook .content').html('<iframe scrolling="no" allowfullscreen src="' + $(this).closest('.container').find('a').attr('href') + '"></iframe>');

        if (typeof ga != 'undefined') {
            ga('send', 'event', 'Site', 'example');
        }
        return false;
    });

    $(document).mouseup(function(e) {
        let container = $('.menu');
        if (!container.is(e.target) && container.has(e.target).length === 0) {
            if ($('.menu ul').is(':visible')) {
                $('.btnLanguage').trigger('click');
            }
        }

        container = $('.btnMenu');
        if (!container.is(e.target) && container.has(e.target).length === 0) {
            if ($('nav .links .navigation').is(':visible') && $('.navigation-xs').is(':visible')) {
                $('.btnMenu').trigger('click');
            }
        }

    });
    
    $('.btnMenu').on('click', function() {
        $('.navigation').toggleClass('show');
        return false;
    });
    
    $('.fp-gif').on('error', function() {
        $('.gen-gif-msg').show();
    });

    $('.fp-gif').on('load', function() {
        $('.gen-gif-msg').hide();
    });
    
    $('.input-placeholder > input').on('keyup blur', function() {
        if ($(this).val() != '') {
            $(this).closest('.input-placeholder').find('label').css('display', 'block');
            setTimeout(() => {
                $(this).closest('.input-placeholder').addClass('active');
            });
        } else {
            $(this).closest('.input-placeholder').find('label').css('display', 'none');
            setTimeout(() => {
                $(this).closest('.input-placeholder').removeClass('active');
            });
        }
    });

    let tmrLogoAnim = [];
    let scrollThreshold = 600;
    if ($('[data-menu-inverse-start]').length > 0) {
        scrollThreshold = $('[data-menu-inverse-start]').offset().top;
    }
    
    $(window).on('scroll', function() {
        if ($(document).scrollTop() > scrollThreshold) {

            if (!$('.landing-nav').hasClass('inverse')) {
                let paths = $('.landing-nav svg.logo path');
                paths.addClass('logo-inverse-initial');
                tmrLogoAnim.forEach(t => clearTimeout(t));
                tmrLogoAnim = [];
                for (let i = 0; i < paths.length; i++) {
                    let tmr = setTimeout(() => {
                        $(paths[i]).addClass('logo-inverse');
                    }, 50 * (i + 1));
                    tmrLogoAnim.push(tmr);
                }
            }
            $('.landing-nav').addClass('inverse');
        } else {

            if ($('.landing-nav').hasClass('inverse')) {
                let paths = $('.landing-nav svg.logo path');
                paths.removeClass('logo-inverse-initial');
                tmrLogoAnim.forEach(t => clearTimeout(t));
                tmrLogoAnim = [];
                for (let i = 0; i < paths.length; i++) {
                    let tmr = setTimeout(() => {
                        $(paths[i]).removeClass('logo-inverse');
                    }, 10 * (i + 1));
                    tmrLogoAnim.push(tmr);
                }
            }
            $('.landing-nav').removeClass('inverse');
        }
    });

});

    },

    getStorage: function(key, def) {
        let cval = localStorage.getItem(key);
        try {
            cval = JSON.parse(cval);
        } catch(e) {
        }

        return cval == null ? def : cval;
    },
    setStorage: function(key, val) {
        localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(val));
        return val;
    },
    getUserSetting: function(key, def) {
        let us = app.getStorage('user-settings', {});
        if (us[key] == null) {
            return def;
        }
        return us[key];
    },
    setUserSetting: function(key, val) {
        let us = app.getStorage('user-settings', {});
        us[key] = val;
        app.setStorage('user-settings', us);
    },
    parseUrl: function (url) {
        var query = {};
        var urlToParse = url || window.location.href;
        var i;
        var params;
        var param;
        var length;
        if (typeof urlToParse === 'string' && urlToParse.length) {
          urlToParse = urlToParse.indexOf('?') > -1 ? urlToParse.replace(/\S*\?/, '') : '';
          params = urlToParse.split('&').filter(function (paramsPart) { return paramsPart !== ''; });
          length = params.length;

          for (i = 0; i < length; i += 1) {
            param = params[i].replace(/#\S+/g, '').split('=');
            query[decodeURIComponent(param[0])] = typeof param[1] === 'undefined' ? undefined : decodeURIComponent(param[1]) || '';
          }
        }
        return query;
    }    
};

captcha = {
    retries: 0,
    currentToken: null,
    getToken: function() {
        return this.currentToken;
    },
    render: async function(sel, cb, cberror) {
        
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            const tabindex = document.querySelector(sel).getAttribute('tabindex');

            document.querySelector(sel).parentElement.querySelector('.captcha-message').innerHTML = "";
            document.querySelector(sel).innerHTML = '';

            if (CAPTCHA_PROVIDER == 'cloudflare') {
                turnstile.render(sel, {
                    sitekey: CAPTCHA_KEY,
                    theme: 'light',
                    size: 'flexible',
                    tabindex: parseInt(tabindex),
                    appearance: 'interaction-only',
                    retry: 'never',
                    execution: 'execute',
                    callback: (token) => {
                        this.currentToken = token;
                        this.retries = 0;
                        resolve(token);
                    },
                    'error-callback': (errorCode) => {
    
                        this.retries++;
                        if (this.retries <= 2) {
                            this.reset(sel).then(resolve).catch(reject);
                        } else {
                            this.retries = 0;
                            reject(CAPTCHA_MESSAGE);
                        }
                    },
                    'expired-callback': () => {
                        this.reset(sel).then(resolve).catch(reject);
                    },
                    'timeout-callback': () => {
                        this.reset(sel).then(resolve).catch(reject);
                    }
                });
                turnstile.execute(sel);
            } else if (CAPTCHA_PROVIDER == 'google') {

                grecaptcha.ready(() => {
                    let action = 'not_defined';
                    if (sel == '#captchaRegister') {
                        action = 'register';
                    } else if (sel == '#captchaRegisterAdmin') {
                        action = 'register_admin';
                    } else if (sel == '#captchaUploadlookbook') {
                        action = 'lookbook';
                    } else if (sel == '#captchaUploadlookbookAfter') {
                        action = 'lookbook_sec';
                    } else if (sel == '#captchaUploadHome') {
                        action = 'home';
                    } else if (sel == '#captchaUploadAfter') {
                        action = 'home_sec';
                    } else if (sel != null && sel.substr(0,14) == '#captchaUpload') {
                        action = 'admin';
                    }

                    grecaptcha.execute(CAPTCHA_KEY, {action: action}).then((token) => {
                        this.currentToken = token;
                        this.retries = 0;                        
                        resolve(token);
                    });
                });
            } else {
                resolve();
            }
        });
    },
    reset: async function(sel) {
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            this.render(sel).then(resolve).catch(reject);
        });
    }
};

function shortName(data) {
    
    let name = null;
    let ver = '';
    
    if ((typeof data).toLowerCase() == "string") {
        name = data;      
    } else if (data.name != null) {
        name = data.name;
    }
    
    if (data.thumbnail != null && data.thumbnail.replace('-thumb.jpg', '').indexOf('-') > 0) {
        let part = data.thumbnail.replace('-thumb.jpg', '').split('-');
        ver = part[1].replace('.pdf', '');
    }
    
    
    return {
        base: name.substr(0, 10),
        basever: name.substr(0, 10) + ver,
        gif: name.substr(0, 10) + ver + '.gif',
        flip: name.substr(0, 10) + ver + '.html',
        thumb: name.substr(0, 10) + ver + '.jpg',
        qr: name.substr(0, 10) + ver + '.png'
    };      

        
}

common.clipboard = {
    copy: function(text) {
        if (!navigator.clipboard) {
            this.clipboard.fallback(text);
            return;
        }

        navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(function () {
            console.log('async clipboard copy');
        }, function (err) {
            console.error('async clipboard error ', err);
        });            
    },
    copyRaw: function(target) {

        var range, select;
        if (document.createRange) {
          range = document.createRange();
          range.selectNode(target)
          select = window.getSelection();
          select.removeAllRanges();
          select.addRange(range);
        } else {
          range = document.body.createTextRange();
          range.moveToElementText(target);
          range.select();
        }            

        try {
            var successful = document.execCommand('copy');
            console.log(successful);
            if (select) {
                select.removeAllRanges();
            }
            return !!successful;
        } catch (err) {
            return false;
        }            
    },
    fallback: function(text) {
        var textArea = document.createElement("textarea");
        textArea.value = text;

        // Avoid scrolling to bottom
        textArea.style.top = "0";
        textArea.style.left = "0";
        textArea.style.position = "fixed";

        document.body.appendChild(textArea);
        this.copyRaw(textArea);
        document.body.removeChild(textArea);            
    }
};

jQuery(function() {

    function formatCurrency(pname) {
        const curr = common.pay.currency;
        const price = common.pay.plans[pname].prices[common.pay.currency];

        if (curr == 'EUR') return price + '€';
        else if (curr == 'GBP') return '£' + price;
        else return '$' + price;
    }

    function formatCurrencyMonth(pname) {
        const curr = common.pay.currency;
        const price = Math.round(common.pay.plans[pname].prices[common.pay.currency] / 12);

        if (curr == 'EUR') return price + '€';
        else if (curr == 'GBP') return '£' + price;
        else return '$' + price;
    }

    function formatCurrencyPrice(pricecurr) {
        const curr = common.pay.currency;
        const price = pricecurr[curr];

        if (curr == 'EUR') return price + '€';
        else if (curr == 'GBP') return '£' + price;
        else return '$' + price;
    }

    function getCurrencyName(curr) {
        if (curr == 'EUR') return 'Euro';
        else if (curr == 'USD') return 'U.S. Dollar';
        else if (curr == 'GBP') return 'British Pound';

function showPayProcessing() {
    $('#preloader').addClass('trans');
    $('#status').show();
    $('#preloader').fadeIn('fast');
}

function hidePayProcessing() {
    $('#preloader').fadeOut('fast');
}

function currentPagePath() {
    try {
        const path = (window.location.pathname || '/') + (window.location.search || '') + (window.location.hash || '');
        return path.charAt(0) === '/' ? path : '/' + path;
    } catch (e) {
        return '/account';
    }
}


function runPreCheckoutSave(done) {
    if (typeof window.heyzinePreCheckoutSave !== 'function') {
        setTimeout(done, 0);
        return;
    }
    let called = false;
    const finish = () => {
        if (called) { return; }
        called = true;
        // Some pages (editor) perform a save through helpers that hide
        // #preloader at the end of the request. Defer continuation one tick
        // so we can restore the checkout loader after that hide.
        setTimeout(done, 0);
    };
    try {
        window.heyzinePreCheckoutSave(finish);
    } catch (e) {
        finish();
        return;
    }
    setTimeout(finish, 5000);
}

function readRewardfulRef() {
    try {
        if (typeof Rewardful !== 'undefined' && Rewardful && Rewardful.referral) {
            return Rewardful.referral;
        }
    } catch (e) { /* noop */ }
    return null;
}

function teamUpgradeBlocked() {
    return typeof common !== 'undefined' && common && common.teamUpgrade && common.teamUpgrade.blocked === true;
}

function planDisplayName(plan) {
    const map = {
        SUBS_STANDARD: 'Standard',
        SUBS_PRO: 'Professional',
        SUBS_PRO_M: 'Professional',
        SUBS_PREMIUM: 'Premium',
        SUBS_PREMIUM_M: 'Premium'
    };
    return map[plan] || '';
}

function goCheckout(plan, currency, returnPath) {
    if (teamUpgradeBlocked()) { showTeamOwnerUpgrade(planDisplayName(plan)); return; }
    if (!plan) { return; }
    // Both success (return) and cancel paths default to the page the user came
    // from so Stripe Checkout — whether the user pays or hits "Back" — drops
    // them right where they were (editor at /admin/view, dashboard, /account,
    // a /plans page, etc.) instead of always /account. The server-side service
    // still validates each value is a same-site path before using it.
    const here = currentPagePath();
    const payload = {
        plan: plan,
        currency: currency || '',
        return: here,
        cancel: here,
    };
    const referral = readRewardfulRef();
    if (referral) { payload.referral = referral; }

    showPayProcessing();

    runPreCheckoutSave(() => {
        showPayProcessing();
        $.post('/payment/checkout', payload, function(res) {
            const data = typeof res === 'string' ? JSON.parse(res) : res;
            if (data.success && data.redirectUrl) {
                document.location.href = data.redirectUrl;
            } else {
                hidePayProcessing();
                $('#mdlPayBackFail').find('.error').html(data.error || 'There was an error starting the checkout.');
                $('#mdlPayBackFail').fadeIn('fast');
            }
        }).fail(function() {
            hidePayProcessing();
            $('#mdlPayBackFail').find('.error').html('There was an error starting the checkout.');
            $('#mdlPayBackFail').fadeIn('fast');
        });
    });
}

function openUpgradeConfirm($btn, plan, returnPath) {
    if (teamUpgradeBlocked()) {
        showTeamOwnerUpgrade(($btn && $btn.attr ? $btn.attr('data-plan-name') : '') || planDisplayName(plan));
        return;
    }
    const $modal = $('#mdlPayUpgradeConfirm');
    if (!$modal.length) {
        // No modal on this page (older view); fall back to direct upgrade.
        submitUpgrade(plan, common.pay.currency, returnPath);
        return;
    }

    const planName = $btn.attr('data-plan-name') || '';
    const charge = $btn.attr('data-upgrade-charge') || '';
    const renewPrice = $btn.attr('data-upgrade-renew-price') || '';
    const renewPeriod = $btn.attr('data-upgrade-renew-period') || 'year';
    const renewDate = $btn.attr('data-upgrade-renew-date') || '';

    const fillTpl = (tpl, vars) => {
        let out = tpl || '';
        Object.keys(vars).forEach(k => {
            out = out.split('{' + k + '}').join(vars[k]);
        });
        return out;
    };

    const titleTpl = planName ? $modal.attr('data-tpl-title') : $modal.attr('data-tpl-title-fallback');
    $modal.find('.upgrade-confirm-title').text(fillTpl(titleTpl, { planName: planName }));

    let messageTpl;
    if (charge && renewPrice && renewDate) {
        messageTpl = renewPeriod === 'month'
            ? $modal.attr('data-tpl-message-month')
            : $modal.attr('data-tpl-message-year');
    } else {
        messageTpl = $modal.attr('data-tpl-message-fallback');
    }
    $modal.find('.upgrade-confirm-message').html(fillTpl(messageTpl, {
        charge: charge,
        renewPrice: renewPrice,
        date: renewDate
    }));

    $modal.attr('data-plan', plan);
    $modal.attr('data-return', returnPath || '/account');

    $modal.show();
    $('html').css('overflow', 'hidden');
}

function submitUpgrade(plan, currency, returnPath) {
    if (teamUpgradeBlocked()) { showTeamOwnerUpgrade(planDisplayName(plan)); return; }
    if (!plan) { return; }
    $('#mdlPlanSelect').hide();

    showPayProcessing();

    runPreCheckoutSave(() => {
        showPayProcessing();
        $.post('/payment/upgrade', { plan: plan, currency: currency || '' }, function(res) {
            const data = typeof res === 'string' ? JSON.parse(res) : res;
            if (data.success) {
                trackPaymentConfirm(returnPath || '/account');
                return;
            }
            if (data.requiresAction && data.paymentIntentClientSecret) {
                const stripe = Stripe(common.pay.stripe.pk);
                stripe.confirmCardPayment(data.paymentIntentClientSecret).then(function(result) {
                    hidePayProcessing();
                    if (result.error) {
                        $('#mdlPayBackFail').find('.error').html(result.error.message);
                        $('#mdlPayBackFail').fadeIn('fast');
                    } else {
                        trackPaymentConfirm(returnPath || '/account');
                    }
                });
                return;
            }
            hidePayProcessing();
            $('#mdlPayBackFail').find('.error').html(data.error || 'There was an error processing the upgrade.');
            $('#mdlPayBackFail').fadeIn('fast');
        }).fail(function() {
            hidePayProcessing();
            $('#mdlPayBackFail').find('.error').html('There was an error processing the upgrade.');
            $('#mdlPayBackFail').fadeIn('fast');
        });
    });
}

function decoratePlanSelectorCtas($scope) {
    if (!$scope || !$scope.length) { return; }
    const $selector = $scope.is('.plan-selector') ? $scope : $scope.find('.plan-selector');
    if (($selector.length ? $selector : $scope).attr('data-server-decorated') === '1') {
        return;
    }

    const currentWeight = (typeof user !== 'undefined' && user.planWeight) ? parseInt(user.planWeight, 10) : null;
    const planWeights = { SUBS_STANDARD: 10, SUBS_PRO: 20, SUBS_PREMIUM: 30 };

    $scope.find('.plan-select-item').each(function() {
        const $item = $(this);
        const planYear = $item.attr('data-plan-year');
        const targetWeight = planWeights[planYear] || null;
        const $cta = $item.find('.btnPlanSelectConfirm');

        $cta.removeClass('btn-current btn-upgrade btn-cta-disabled');
        $cta.attr('data-action', 'subscribe');

        if (currentWeight != null && targetWeight != null) {
            if (targetWeight === currentWeight) {
                $cta.text('Current plan').addClass('btn-current btn-cta-disabled');
            } else if (targetWeight > currentWeight) {
                $cta.text('Upgrade').addClass('btn-upgrade');
                $cta.attr('data-action', 'upgrade');
            } else {
                $cta.text('Subscribe');
            }
        } else {
            $cta.text('Subscribe');
        }
    });
    updatePlanSelectorCtasForPeriod($scope);
}

function updatePlanSelectorCtasForPeriod($scope) {
    if (!$scope || !$scope.length) { return; }
    const isMonthly = $scope.find('.planSelectPeriodInput').is(':checked');
    $scope.find('.btnPlanSelectConfirm').each(function() {
        const $cta = $(this);
        const hasPeriodConfig = $cta.is('[data-action-year], [data-action-month], [data-label-year], [data-label-month]');
        if (!hasPeriodConfig) { return; }

        const actionYear = $cta.attr('data-action-year') || $cta.attr('data-action') || 'subscribe';
        const actionMonth = $cta.attr('data-action-month') || actionYear;
        const labelYear = $cta.attr('data-label-year') || $cta.text();
        const labelMonth = $cta.attr('data-label-month') || labelYear;

        const nextAction = isMonthly ? actionMonth : actionYear;
        const nextLabel = isMonthly ? labelMonth : labelYear;

        $cta.attr('data-action', nextAction);
        $cta.text(nextLabel);
        $cta.removeClass('btn-current btn-upgrade btn-cta-disabled');
        if (nextAction === 'current') {
            $cta.addClass('btn-current btn-cta-disabled');
        } else if (nextAction === 'upgrade') {
            $cta.addClass('btn-upgrade');
        }
    });
}

function openPlanSelector(returnPath) {
    const $modal = $('#mdlPlanSelect');
    if (!$modal.length) { return; }

    $modal.attr('data-return', returnPath || '/account');

    decoratePlanSelectorCtas($modal);

    $modal.find('.selCurrency').val(common.pay.currency);

    // Always open in the default (yearly) state.
    $modal.find('.planSelectPeriodInput').prop('checked', false);
    $modal.find('.plan-selector').removeClass('is-monthly');
    $modal.find('.product-price-month').hide();
    $modal.find('.product-price-year').show();
    updatePlanSelectorCtasForPeriod($modal.find('.plan-selector'));

    $modal.show();
    $('html').css('overflow', 'hidden');
}

// ---- Packs / intent modal (unchanged behaviour) ----

function showPayModal(modal) {
    var stripe = Stripe(common.pay.stripe.pk);
    var elements = stripe.elements({ locale: common.pay.stripe.lang });

    var style = {
      base: {
        color: '#32325d',
        fontFamily: 'HKGrotesk-Regular, Open Sans, sans-serif',
        fontSmoothing: 'antialiased',
        fontSize: '16px',
        '::placeholder': {
          color: '#aab7c4'
        }
      },
      invalid: {
        color: '#fa755a',
        iconColor: '#fa755a'
      }
    };

    var card = elements.create('card', {style: style});
    card.mount(modal + ' .card-element');

    card.on('change', function(event) {
      var displayError = $(modal).find('.card-errors').get(0);
      if (event.error) {
        displayError.textContent = event.error.message;
      } else {
        displayError.textContent = '';
      }
    });

    var form = $(modal).find('.payment-form').get(0);
    form.addEventListener('submit', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();

        $('.pay-loading').css('display', 'flex');

        let backUrl = null;
        if ($(modal).attr('data-return') != null) {
            backUrl = $(modal).attr('data-return');
        }

        var billingDetails = {
            email: user.email,
            name: user.name
        };

        var clientSecret = $(modal).find('.payment-form').attr('data-tk');
        stripe.confirmCardPayment(clientSecret, {
            payment_method: {
              card: card,
              billing_details: billingDetails
            }
          }).then(function(result) {
            if (result.error) {
                var errorElement = $(modal).find('.card-errors').get(0);
                errorElement.textContent = result.error.message;
                $('.pay-loading').css('display', 'none');
            } else {
                if (result.paymentIntent.status === 'succeeded') {
                    trackPaymentConfirm(backUrl);
                }
            }
          });
    });

    $(modal + '.backdrop').show();
    $('html').css('overflow', 'hidden');
    if (typeof ga != 'undefined') {
        ga('send', 'event', 'Site', 'pricing-view');
    }
}

function trackPaymentConfirmed(backUrl) {
    if (backUrl == null) {
        document.location.href = document.location.href.split('#')[0];
    } else {
        document.location.href = backUrl;
    }
}


function trackPaymentConfirm(backUrl) {
    showPayProcessing();
    $('#mdlPlanSelect').hide();
    $('#mdlPayKeep').hide();
    $('#mdlPayKeepPurchase').hide();

    GTRACKPAY = setInterval(() => {
        $.getJSON('/payment/status', function(data) {
            if (data.stop) {
                clearInterval(GTRACKPAY);
                hidePayProcessing();
            } else if (data.status == 1) {

                if (typeof app != 'undefined' && app.bus != null && typeof Vue != 'undefined') {
                    app.bus().$emit('sideSave');
                }

                if (typeof gtag != 'undefined') {
                    gtag('event', 'conversion', {
                        'send_to': 'AW-624164228/wQ7-CNu1lpIZEIT7z6kC',
                        'value': data.price,
                        'currency': 'USD'
                    });
                }

                setTimeout(() => {
                    trackPaymentConfirmed(backUrl);
                }, 1000);

            } else if (data.status == -1) {
                clearInterval(GTRACKPAY);
                hidePayProcessing();
                $('#mdlPayBackFail').find('.error').html(data.message);
                $('#mdlPayBackFail').fadeIn('fast');
            }

        });
    }, 3000);
}


function firePostCheckoutTracking() {
    $.getJSON('/payment/status', function(data) {
        if (data == null || data.status != 1) { return; }

        if (typeof gtag != 'undefined') {
            gtag('event', 'conversion', {
                'send_to': 'AW-624164228/wQ7-CNu1lpIZEIT7z6kC',
                'value': data.price,
                'currency': 'USD'
            });
        }

        try {
            if (typeof Rewardful !== 'undefined' && Rewardful && typeof Rewardful.convert === 'function') {
                Rewardful.convert({ email: (typeof user !== 'undefined' && user.email) ? user.email : undefined });
            }
        } catch (e) { /* noop */ }

        try {
            if (typeof plausible === 'function') {
                plausible('Subscription', { props: { amount: data.price, currency: 'USD' } });
            }
        } catch (e) { /* noop */ }
    });
}

    let scrollThrottle = null;

    $(window).on('scroll', function() {
        
        if (scrollThrottle != null) {
            clearTimeout(scrollThrottle);
        }
        scrollThrottle = setTimeout(() => {
            let navs = $('nav .links a');
            for (let i = 0; i < navs.length; i++) {
                let sel = $(navs[i]).attr('href');
                if (sel.length > 1 && sel.substr(0, 1) == '#' && $(sel).offset() != null && $(document).scrollTop() >= Math.round($(sel).offset().top)) {
                    if (!$(navs[i]).hasClass('selected')) {
                        $(navs).removeClass('selected');
                        $(navs[i]).addClass('selected');
                    }
                }
            }

            if ($(window).height() + $(document).scrollTop() >= $(document).height()) {
                if (!$('nav [href="#contact"]').hasClass('selected')) {
                    $(navs).removeClass('selected');
                    $('nav [href="#contact"]').addClass('selected');
                }
            }
        }, 100);
    });

    $('.btnModalLinks').on('click', function() {

        const isAnon =(typeof user == 'undefined' || !user.logged);
        common.linkCodes.show(heyzine.config, { title: $('.txtTitle').val(), subtitle: $('.txtSubtitle').val() }, heyzine.config.domain, true, null, isAnon);
        
        if (typeof ga != 'undefined') {
            ga('send', 'event', 'Conversion', 'link-codes');
        }

        $('#mdlLinks.backdrop').fadeIn('fast');
        $('html').css('overflow', 'hidden');
        return false;
    }); 
    
   
    window.uploaded = function(data) {

        if (FLIP_CFG.mode == 'PDF') {
            heyzine.destroy();
        }

        const res = JSON.parse(data.jqXHR.responseText);
        FLIP_CFG.mode = 'PDF';
        FLIP_CFG.name = res.hash;
        FLIP_CFG.thumbnail = res.hashPath + '-thumb.jpg',
        FLIP_CFG.width = res.width;
        FLIP_CFG.height = res.height;
        FLIP_CFG.admin_key = res.admin_key;
        FLIP_CFG.num_pages = res.num_pages;
        FLIP_CFG.size = res.size;
        FLIP_CFG.id = res.id;
        FLIP_CFG.design.arrows = 1;
        FLIP_CFG.design.show_edges = (res.num_pages > 5 ? 1 : 0);
        FLIP_CFG.layers = res.layers;
                
        heyzine.load(CDN_PATH + '/files/uploaded/' + res.hashPath, FLIP_CFG).then(() => {	
            heyzineDesign.afterLoad(FLIP_CFG.design);
            landingOverFlipbook();
            converted();
        });
    }    
});

function converted() {

    $('.hero-section').addClass('hero-section-opened'); 
    $('.hero-title').hide();
    $('.hero-page-effect').hide();
    $('.preview-button').fadeOut();            
    $('#flipbook-customize').fadeIn();

    $('.btnAdminGo').on('click', function() {
        window.open(app.getAbsoluteLangUrl('/admin/view?n=' + heyzine.config.name + '&adminKey=' + heyzine.config.admin_key), 'target=_BLANK');
        if (typeof ga != 'undefined') {
            ga('send', 'event', 'Conversion', 'editor');
        }
        return false;                
    });
    if (typeof ga != 'undefined') {
        ga('send', 'event', 'Conversion', 'converted');
    }
}

.progress-line:before {

@-webkit-keyframes running-progress {
  0% { margin-left: 0px; margin-right: 100%; }
  50% { margin-left: 25%; margin-right: 0%; }
  100% { margin-left: 100%; margin-right: 0; }
}

}

}

    left: 0;
    width: 50%;    
    -webkit-animation: running-progress 2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) infinite;

/* The element to hover over */
.qs {
    position: relative;
}
.qs .popover {
  background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85);
  border-radius: 5px;
  bottom: 42px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
  color: #fff;
  display: none;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-family: "Helvetica", sans-serif;
  left: -5px;
  padding: 7px 10px;
  position: absolute;
    width: 100vw;
    max-width: 300px;
  z-index: 4;
}
.qs .popover:before {
  border-top: 7px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85);
  border-right: 7px solid transparent;
  border-left: 7px solid transparent;
  bottom: -7px;
  content: "";
  display: block;
  left: 19px;
  margin-left: -7px;
  position: absolute;
}
.qs:hover .popover {
  display: block;
  -webkit-animation: fade-in 0.3s linear 1, move-up 0.3s linear 1;
  -moz-animation: fade-in 0.3s linear 1, move-up 0.3s linear 1;
  -ms-animation: fade-in 0.3s linear 1, move-up 0.3s linear 1;
}

.pop-info {
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-decoration-style: dashed;
    text-underline-offset: 3px;
    text-decoration-thickness: 1px;
}

@-webkit-keyframes fade-in {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
  }
}

.price-toggle {
    position: relative;

    position: absolute;

/*******************************
PAGE PRELOADER
    Shared between admin/stats dashboards (page-load splash) and the
    marketing / plans / features pages (Stripe checkout overlay). Toggled
    via $.preload() in utils.js or directly via $('#preloader').fadeIn()
    / fadeOut() from payment.js. The `.trans` variant is the transparent
    overlay used during AJAX flows.
*******************************/
    #preloader {
        position: fixed;
        top: 0;
        left: 0;
        right: 0;
        bottom: 0;
        z-index: 99999;
        background: #19a974;
    }

    #status {
        position: relative;
        display: flex;
        justify-content: center;
        align-items: center;
        height: 100%;
    }

    #status svg {
        width: 100%;
        height: auto;
        display: block;
        max-width: 75px;
    }

    #status svg path {
        fill: white;
        animation: anipreloaderfade 2.5s linear infinite;
    }

    #status svg .animate-path {
        fill: none;
        stroke-dasharray: 160;
        stroke-dashoffset: 160;
        animation: anipreloader 2.5s linear infinite;
        stroke-width: 3px;
        stroke: white;
    }

    .trans #status {
        position: relative;
        display: flex;
        justify-content: center;
        align-items: center;
        height: 25px;
        width: 50%;
        left: 25%;
        top: calc(50% - 100px);
        background-color: #ffffff7a;
        border-radius: 18px;
        z-index: -2
    }

    .trans #status svg {
        width: 100%;
        height: auto;
        display: block;
        max-width: 75px;
        margin-top: 23px;
    }

    #preloader.trans {
        background: #0000004f;
    }

    .trans #status::after {
        content: '';
        background-color: #3eaa83;
        width: 30%;
        position: absolute;
        left: 0;
        top: 0;
        height: 100%;
        border-radius: 18px;
        animation: anitrans 3s linear infinite;
        z-index: -1;
    }

    @keyframes anitrans {
      0% {
        left: 0%;
        width: 0%;
      }
      50% {
        left: 25%;
        width: 50%;
      }
      100% {
        width: 0%;
        left: 100%;
      }
    }

    @keyframes anipreloader {
      0% {
        stroke-dashoffset: 160;
        opacity: 0;
      }
      80% {
        stroke-dashoffset: 0;
        opacity: 1;
      }
      95% {
        stroke-dashoffset: 0;
        opacity: 0;
      }
      100% {
        stroke-dashoffset: 0;
        opacity: 0;
      }
    }

    @keyframes anipreloaderfade {
      0% {
        opacity: 0;
      }
      50% {
        stroke-dashoffset: 0;
        opacity: 1;
      }
      95% {
        stroke-dashoffset: 0;
        opacity: 1;
      }
      100% {
        opacity: 0;
      }
    }
